<script>
  // Initialize a flag to ensure event handlers are added only once
  let handlersAdded = false;

  function checkEventTargetParent(event) {
    let currentNode = event.target;
    const body = document.body;

    while (currentNode && currentNode !== body) {
      if (currentNode.tagName === "DIV" && currentNode.getAttribute("data-action-type") === 'NO_ACTION') {
        return true;
      }

      currentNode = currentNode.parentNode;
    }

    return false;
  }

  function dispatchBreadClickEvents(event) {
    //console.log(event);
    let CE_SignInToApply = new Event("CE_SignInToApply");
    let CE_ApplyNow = new Event("CE_ApplyNow");

    if (checkEventTargetParent(event)) {
      event.target.dispatchEvent(CE_SignInToApply);
    } else {
      event.target.dispatchEvent(CE_ApplyNow);
    }
  }

  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {

    // Check if event handlers have already been added
    if (!handlersAdded) {
      const breadParentIds = ['#placement-footer',
        '#placement-footer-mobile',
        '#placement-cart',
        '#placement-cart-mobile',
        '#placement-credit-card-landing',
        '#placement-credit-card-landing-2',
        '#placement-dashboard',
        '#placement-stylerewards-loyalty',
        "#bread-payments-product-placement",
        "#bread-payments-category-placement",
        "#bread-payments-homepage-placement",
        "#bread-payments-search-placement",
        "#bread-payments-banner-placement",
        "#bread-payments-checkout-placement",
        "#bread-payments-header-placement",
      ];

      breadParentIds.forEach((id) => {
        // Query all elements with this selector to handle potential duplicates
        const elements = document.querySelectorAll(id);

        elements.forEach((element) => {
          console.log(`Adding event listener to: $ {
                    id
                  }

                  `);
          //element.style.border = "2px solid red"; 
          element.addEventListener("click", dispatchBreadClickEvents);
        }

        );
      }

      );

      // Set the flag to true to avoid adding handlers again
      handlersAdded = true;
      console.log("Event listeners added to all instances of specified elements.");
    }
  }

  );
</script>

<script>
  // Initialize a flag to ensure event handlers are added only once
  let handlersAdded = false;

  function checkEventTargetParent(event) {
    let currentNode = event.target;
    const body = document.body;

    while (currentNode && currentNode !== body) {
      if (currentNode.tagName === "DIV" && currentNode.getAttribute("data-action-type") === 'NO_ACTION') {
        return true;
      }

      currentNode = currentNode.parentNode;
    }

    return false;
  }

  function dispatchBreadClickEvents(event) {
    //console.log(event);
    let CE_SignInToApply = new Event("CE_SignInToApply");
    let CE_ApplyNow = new Event("CE_ApplyNow");

    if (checkEventTargetParent(event)) {
      event.target.dispatchEvent(CE_SignInToApply);
    } else {
      event.target.dispatchEvent(CE_ApplyNow);
    }
  }

  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {

    // Check if event handlers have already been added
    if (!handlersAdded) {
      const breadParentIds = ['#placement-footer',
        '#placement-footer-mobile',
        '#placement-cart',
        '#placement-cart-mobile',
        '#placement-credit-card-landing',
        '#placement-credit-card-landing-2',
        '#placement-dashboard',
        '#placement-stylerewards-loyalty',
        "#bread-payments-product-placement",
        "#bread-payments-category-placement",
        "#bread-payments-homepage-placement",
        "#bread-payments-search-placement",
        "#bread-payments-banner-placement",
        "#bread-payments-checkout-placement",
        "#bread-payments-header-placement",
      ];

      breadParentIds.forEach((id) => {
        // Query all elements with this selector to handle potential duplicates
        const elements = document.querySelectorAll(id);

        elements.forEach((element) => {
          console.log(`Adding event listener to: $ {
                    id
                  }

                  `);
          //element.style.border = "2px solid red"; 
          element.addEventListener("click", dispatchBreadClickEvents);
        }

        );
      }

      );

      // Set the flag to true to avoid adding handlers again
      handlersAdded = true;
      console.log("Event listeners added to all instances of specified elements.");
    }
  }

  );
</script>

        }

    }

                    price: {
                        value: orderItem.salePrice / orderItem.quantity,
                        currency: 'USD',

<script>
  // Initialize a flag to ensure event handlers are added only once
  let handlersAdded = false;

  function checkEventTargetParent(event) {
    let currentNode = event.target;
    const body = document.body;

    while (currentNode && currentNode !== body) {
      if (currentNode.tagName === "DIV" && currentNode.getAttribute("data-action-type") === 'NO_ACTION') {
        return true;
      }

      currentNode = currentNode.parentNode;
    }

    return false;
  }

  function dispatchBreadClickEvents(event) {
    //console.log(event);
    let CE_SignInToApply = new Event("CE_SignInToApply");
    let CE_ApplyNow = new Event("CE_ApplyNow");

    if (checkEventTargetParent(event)) {
      event.target.dispatchEvent(CE_SignInToApply);
    } else {
      event.target.dispatchEvent(CE_ApplyNow);
    }
  }

  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {

    // Check if event handlers have already been added
    if (!handlersAdded) {
      const breadParentIds = ['#placement-footer',
        '#placement-footer-mobile',
        '#placement-cart',
        '#placement-cart-mobile',
        '#placement-credit-card-landing',
        '#placement-credit-card-landing-2',

        "#bread-payments-banner-placement",
        "#bread-payments-checkout-placement",
        "#bread-payments-header-placement",
      ];

      breadParentIds.forEach((id) => {
        // Query all elements with this selector to handle potential duplicates
        const elements = document.querySelectorAll(id);

        elements.forEach((element) => {
          console.log(`Adding event listener to: $ {
                    id
                  }

                  `);
          //element.style.border = "2px solid red"; 
          element.addEventListener("click", dispatchBreadClickEvents);
        }

        );
      }

      );

      // Set the flag to true to avoid adding handlers again
      handlersAdded = true;
      console.log("Event listeners added to all instances of specified elements.");
    }
  }

  );

        if (window.OnetrustActiveGroups) {

        }
        return true;

    function attentiveSimplifiedPageType() {

        }
        if (pageType == 'checkout:page' || pageType == 'checkout:billing' || pageType == 'checkout:shipping') {
            return 'checkout'
        }
        return pageType
    }

    function attentiveProductDetail() {
        return [{
            productId: premiumBrandsDL.productDetail.productID,
            productVariantId: premiumBrandsDL.productDetail.skuInfo.sku,
            name: premiumBrandsDL.productDetail.prodTitle,
            productImage: premiumBrandsDL.productDetail.image,
            price: {
                value: premiumBrandsDL.productDetail.salePrice,
                currency: 'USD',
            },
            quantity: 1,
        }];
    }

    function attentiveUserDetail() {
        let identityPayload = {}; if (premiumBrandsDL && premiumBrandsDL.order && premiumBrandsDL.order.payment && premiumBrandsDL.order.payment[0].emailId) { identityPayload.email = premiumBrandsDL.order.payment[0].emailId; } else { if (premiumBrandsDL.global.emailID) { identityPayload.email = premiumBrandsDL.global.emailID; } } const attentivePhone = premiumBrandsDL.order.phoneNumber; if (attentivePhone) { identityPayload.phone = attentivePhone; } return identityPayload;
    }

    function attentiveOrderItems() {
        var items = [];
        var orderItems = premiumBrandsDL.order.items;
        if (orderItems && orderItems.length) {
            orderItems.forEach(function (orderItem) {
                items.push({
                    productId: orderItem.productID,
                    productVariantId: orderItem.skuInfo.sku,
                    name: orderItem.prodTitle,
                    price: {
                        value: orderItem.salePrice / orderItem.quantity,
                        currency: 'USD',
                    },
                    quantity: orderItem.quantity,
                })
            });
        }
        return items;
    }

    function attentiveProductView() {
        window.attentive.analytics.productView(
            {
                items: attentiveProductDetail(),
                user: attentiveUserDetail()
            }
        )
    }

    function attentiveAddToCart() {
        window.attentive.analytics.addToCart(
            {
                items: attentiveProductDetail(),
                cart: { cartId: premiumBrandsDL.order.basketID },
                user: attentiveUserDetail()
            }
        )
    }

    function attentivePurchase() {
        window.attentive.analytics.purchase(
            {
                items: attentiveOrderItems(),
                cart: { cartId: premiumBrandsDL.order.basketID },
                order: { orderId: premiumBrandsDL.order.orderID },
                user: attentiveUserDetail()
            }
        )
    }

    function attentiveIdentify() {
        let identityPayload = attentiveUserDetail();
        const attentiveCustomerID = premiumBrandsDL.global.customerID;
        if (attentiveCustomerID && attentiveCustomerID != 'GuestUser') {
            identityPayload.externalIdentifiers = [{
                name: 'Customer_ID',
                value: attentiveCustomerID
            }];
        }
        if (Object.keys(identityPayload).length) {
            window.attentive.analytics.identify(identityPayload);
        }
    }

    function attentiveReady() {
        return window.attentive && window.attentive.analytics && window.attentive.analytics.identify
            && window.attentive.analytics.productView && window.attentive.analytics.addToCart
            && window.attentive.analytics.purchase;
    }

    function executeAttentive() {
        let attInterval = setInterval(() => {
            if (attentiveReady()) {
                clearInterval(attInterval);
                attentiveIdentify();
                switch (attentiveSimplifiedPageType()) {
                    case 'product':

                    case 'quickView':

                        break;
                    case 'addToCart':

                        break;

                        break;

<script>
  // Initialize a flag to ensure event handlers are added only once
  let handlersAdded = false;

  function checkEventTargetParent(event) {
    let currentNode = event.target;
    const body = document.body;

    while (currentNode && currentNode !== body) {
      if (currentNode.tagName === "DIV" && currentNode.getAttribute("data-action-type") === 'NO_ACTION') {
        return true;
      }

      currentNode = currentNode.parentNode;
    }

    return false;
  }

  function dispatchBreadClickEvents(event) {
    //console.log(event);
    let CE_SignInToApply = new Event("CE_SignInToApply");
    let CE_ApplyNow = new Event("CE_ApplyNow");

    if (checkEventTargetParent(event)) {
      event.target.dispatchEvent(CE_SignInToApply);
    } else {
      event.target.dispatchEvent(CE_ApplyNow);
    }
  }

  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {

    // Check if event handlers have already been added
    if (!handlersAdded) {
      const breadParentIds = ['#placement-footer',
        '#placement-footer-mobile',
        '#placement-cart',
        '#placement-cart-mobile',
        '#placement-credit-card-landing',

        "#bread-payments-banner-placement",
        "#bread-payments-checkout-placement",
        "#bread-payments-header-placement",
      ];

      breadParentIds.forEach((id) => {
        // Query all elements with this selector to handle potential duplicates
        const elements = document.querySelectorAll(id);

        elements.forEach((element) => {
          console.log(`Adding event listener to: $ {
                    id
                  }

                  `);
          //element.style.border = "2px solid red"; 
          element.addEventListener("click", dispatchBreadClickEvents);
        }

        );
      }

      );

      // Set the flag to true to avoid adding handlers again
      handlersAdded = true;
      console.log("Event listeners added to all instances of specified elements.");
    }
  }

  );

    let currentNode = event.target;
    const body = document.body;

    while (currentNode && currentNode !== body) {
      if (currentNode.tagName === "DIV" && currentNode.getAttribute("data-action-type") === 'NO_ACTION') {
        return true;
      }

      currentNode = currentNode.parentNode;
    }

    return false;

    let CE_SignInToApply = new Event("CE_SignInToApply");

    if (checkEventTargetParent(event)) {
      event.target.dispatchEvent(CE_SignInToApply);
    } else {
      event.target.dispatchEvent(CE_ApplyNow);
    }
  }
